entries.label: VIBack

tags.subject: central sword, scrollwork clouds, weapon ornaments, sash banner
tags.style: bold filled silhouette with cutout detail
tags.placement: across the upper back spanning both shoulder blades

entries.description: An upright sword pierces the center of a long horizontal band, anchored by billowing cloud scrollwork and ornamental weapon trinkets that trail out symmetrically to either side. Smaller charms, rings and curling motifs hang from the band like a stylized armory sash, giving the piece a wide, banner-like silhouette.

entries.label: Succubus Butt

tags.subject: twin filigree wings, peaked arch, mirrored scrollwork
tags.style: dense ornate baroque linework, bilateral symmetry
tags.placement: across the upper buttocks framing the lower back

entries.description: Two heavy ornamental wings of dense baroque filigree sweep outward from a central peak, mirroring one another in tight curls and pointed flourishes. The silhouette forms a downward chevron, almost a heraldic crest, with interlaced scrollwork filling the wing bodies.

entries.label: Wolf Belly 1

tags.subject: snarling wolf head, blooming rose, trailing vines
tags.placement: on the lower belly just below the navel, set to the right

entries.description: A snarling wolf's head stares out beside a full-bloom rose, the two motifs locked together by thorny vines and tribal flames that spiral away from their base. Leaves and dotted accents trail off the lower edge, giving the design a vertical, descending pull.

entries.label: Wolf Belly 2

tags.subject: stoic wolf head, blooming rose, vine flourishes
tags.placement: on the lower belly just below the navel, set to the left

entries.description: A wolf's head with a calmer, watchful expression sits beside a heavy rose bloom, the two bound by curling vines and pointed tribal flames. Small leaves break off the design as it tapers downward, giving it the feel of a stencil pulled from the same set as its mirror.

entries.label: Helping Hand Breasts

tags.subject: two skeletal hands, splayed phalanges, mirrored pair
tags.style: filled silhouette with anatomical bone outlines
tags.placement: cupped across the underside of both breasts

entries.description: A pair of skeletal hands, palms inward and fingers splayed wide, curve up from below as if cradling from underneath. The bones are rendered in crisp filled black with clean white joint gaps, giving each hand a clear anatomical read and a mirrored symmetry across the centerline.

entries.label: Feathers Underboob

tags.subject: dreamcatcher web, outspread feather wings, hanging gem
tags.style: filled silhouette with intricate inner detail
tags.placement: beneath the breasts spanning the underbust

entries.description: A circular dreamcatcher web sits at the center, flanked by two long feathered wings that stretch horizontally to either side. A teardrop gem hangs below the web on a beaded chain, with smaller pendants dangling from the wing edges to give the piece a heavy, ornamental drape.

entries.label: Roses Underboob 1

tags.subject: single dark rose, curling vines, scattered leaves
tags.placement: beneath the right breast curving outward

entries.description: A solid black rose blooms at the heart of a flourish of curling vines, with whip-thin tendrils and scattered leaves spiraling out to the right. A trail of small dots arcs away from the base, lending the composition a sense of windswept motion.

entries.label: Roses Underboob 2

tags.subject: single dark rose, curling vines, scattered leaves
tags.placement: beneath the left breast curving outward

entries.description: A solid black rose anchors a tangle of curling vines and leaves that sweep outward to the left, mirroring its companion piece. A dotted trail follows the curve of the lower vine, giving the design an airy, drifting feel despite the heavy central bloom.

entries.label: Snake Underboob

tags.subject: coiling serpent, central rose, leafy stems
tags.placement: down the sternum between the breasts

entries.description: A long scaled serpent coils vertically around a single open rose at its midpoint, head rearing up at the top and tail curling down below. Leafy stems weave between the coils, and the whole figure is drawn in fine outline with stippled scales rather than filled black.

entries.label: Evelynn Womb

tags.subject: winged heart, demonic horns, trailing pendant
tags.placement: low on the belly just above the pubic mound

entries.description: A small horned heart sits at the center of two batlike wings that spread wide on either side, each wing tipped with curling claws. A pointed descending ornament drops from the base like a stylized tail, framing the piece as a single horizontal sigil with strong gothic flavor.

entries.label: Flowers Chest 1

tags.subject: diagonal floral garland, repeating blossoms, leafy stems
tags.placement: diagonally across the right collarbone and upper chest

entries.description: A long garland of paired blossoms and leafy stems runs on a diagonal line, the flowers repeating in a near-rhythmic pattern from one end to the other. The silhouette is delicate and lacy, reading like a draped chain of flowers laid across the skin rather than a single bloom.

entries.label: Flowers Chest 2

tags.subject: diagonal floral garland, repeating blossoms, leafy stems
tags.placement: diagonally across the left collarbone and upper chest

entries.description: A mirrored floral garland of paired blossoms sweeps diagonally across, leaves and tendrils punctuating each cluster. The piece keeps the same lace-like rhythm as its counterpart, scaled to drape softly along the line of the collarbone.

entries.label: Lotus Underboob

tags.subject: stylized lotus, hanging gem chains, diamond crown
tags.placement: beneath the breasts centered on the sternum

entries.description: A symmetric lotus opens at the center with a small flame inside its core, crowned above by a faceted diamond suspended on a beaded thread. Two beaded chains arc outward from the petals and dip down on either side, ending in small pointed pendants for a temple-jewelry feel.

entries.label: Lotus Underboob V 2

tags.subject: ornate lotus bloom, draped bead garlands, teardrop pendants
tags.style: fine linework with hanging bead detail
tags.placement: beneath the breasts centered on the sternum

entries.description: A taller, more elaborate lotus rises from a flat base with finely engraved petals and a flame at its core. Multiple strands of beaded chain sag in graceful curves below, each ending in a teardrop pendant, giving the lower half a chandelier-like weight.

entries.label: Lock Womb

tags.subject: heart-shaped padlock, ornate keyhole, filigree corners
tags.placement: low on the belly just above the pubic mound

entries.description: A heart-shaped padlock hangs from a stout shackle, its face engraved with a central keyhole crest and filigree scrollwork blooming from each upper corner. The outline is thin and precise, more like an etched piece of jewelry than a heavy tribal mark.

entries.label: Lock Butt

tags.subject: spade-shaped lock, ornate keyhole, filigree corners
tags.placement: across the upper buttocks framing the lower back

entries.description: A spade or inverted-heart lock sits at the center, its keyhole flanked by symmetric filigree scrolls. A simple loop hangs from the bottom point, finishing the silhouette like a key fob, with all detail rendered in clean engraved outline.

entries.label: Lock Chest

tags.subject: heart-shaped padlock, ornate keyhole, filigree corners
tags.placement: centered high on the chest between the collarbones

entries.description: A heart-shaped padlock with a heavy shackle sits centered, its face engraved with an ornate keyhole plate and symmetric flourishes at each upper lobe. The whole piece reads like a delicate locket charm, drawn in thin outline rather than filled silhouette.

entries.label: Raiden Neck

tags.subject: three-comma swirl, circular roundel, mitsudomoe motif
tags.placement: centered at the base of the throat above the collarbones

entries.description: A bold black circle encloses three comma-shaped swirls that chase one another around a central pivot. The negative-space curves between them form crescents, giving the piece the look of a traditional crested seal.

entries.label: Degurechaff Chest

tags.subject: twin winged dragons, mirrored pair, heraldic crest
tags.style: ornate symmetric tribal with fine inner detail
tags.placement: centered high on the chest between the collarbones

entries.description: Two facing dragons rear up with wings flared, their bodies and tails woven into a heraldic shield-like silhouette. Dense ornamental scrollwork fills the wing membranes and frames the base, creating a strict mirror across the vertical axis.

entries.label: Widowmaker Back

tags.subject: long-legged spider, splayed legs, segmented body
tags.placement: across the upper back centered between the shoulder blades

entries.description: A large spider stretches its eight angular legs straight out in a vertical, taut posture, each limb rendered as crisp geometric segments. The body sits low at the bottom while the long forelegs reach upward, giving the figure a tense, climbing presence.

entries.label: Widowmaker Arm

tags.subject: gothic blackletter text, jagged webbing, banner script
tags.placement: wrapped around the upper arm like a script band

entries.description: A central word in sprayed blackletter type runs across a backdrop of jagged crack-like webbing, with two smaller lines of matching script set above and below. The composition reads as a graphic banner, all type and torn-web texture rather than figurative imagery.

entries.label: Floral Thigh 1

tags.subject: clustered peonies, leafy stems, hanging bead chains
tags.placement: down the outer side of the right thigh

entries.description: A cluster of full peonies and tight buds gathers at the top, their leafy stems winding downward into a sweep of dotted chains and small dangling beads. The piece is drawn in thin botanical outline, light and airy compared to fully filled designs.

entries.label: Floral Thigh 2

tags.subject: clustered peonies, leafy stems, hanging bead chains
tags.placement: down the outer side of the left thigh

entries.description: Mirroring its companion, a bouquet of peonies and buds anchors the top of the design while leafy stems trail down into beaded dot strands. The botanical linework is delicate and the negative space keeps the piece feeling sketched rather than heavy.

entries.label: Flowers Thigh 1

tags.subject: two layered roses, leafy stems, diamond geometric frame
tags.placement: down the outer side of the right thigh

entries.description: Two large roses stack vertically inside an elongated diamond outline, leaves curling around their stems. A dotted arc and rhomboid border ghost behind the blooms, lending the otherwise botanical piece a tidy geometric scaffolding.

entries.label: Flowers Thigh 2

tags.subject: two layered roses, leafy stems, diamond geometric frame
tags.placement: down the outer side of the left thigh

entries.description: A near-twin of its partner, two stacked roses sit inside an elongated dotted diamond, framed by curling leaves. The outline botanical style and bead-trail border read as a neat, framed bouquet rather than a freeform flower piece.

entries.label: Dragon Boob

tags.subject: coiled tribal dragon, encircling tail, snarling head
tags.placement: centered high on the chest between the collarbones

entries.description: A tribal dragon coils tightly into a roughly circular form, its head turned inward and its long tail looping back to close the ring. Flame-like flourishes spike off the body, and the entire creature reads as one continuous black silhouette.

entries.label: Deuslo Vult Belly

tags.subject: cursive script phrase, two flowing words
tags.placement: down the centerline of the belly toward the navel

entries.description: Two words in tall, flowing cursive run vertically down the body, each letter drawn with sweeping connected loops and a fine taper. The piece is pure typography, designed to read as a single elegant calligraphic phrase rather than an image.

entries.label: Siren Back

tags.subject: horned vessel-figure, writhing tendrils, lantern shape
tags.placement: down the upper back along the spine

entries.description: A tall lantern-like figure with curling horns and a hooded silhouette stands at the center, wreathed in long tendrils that twist out in every direction. The base coils outward into a nest of writhing arms, giving the piece an eldritch, vaguely sea-creature presence.

entries.label: Dragon Snake Thigh 1

tags.subject: vertical serpentine dragon, mane and whiskers, curling tail
tags.placement: down the outer side of the left thigh

entries.description: A long serpentine dragon climbs vertically with whiskered head facing outward and clawed limbs curling along its sinuous body. The composition is a clean filled silhouette in the classic east-asian style, head at the top and tail flaring at the bottom.

entries.label: Dragon Snake Thigh 2

tags.subject: vertical serpentine dragon, mane and whiskers, curling tail
tags.placement: down the outer side of the right thigh

entries.description: A mirrored serpentine dragon descends in a long S-curve, its whiskered head set at the upper end and its tail flaring at the lower. The body is rendered as a single bold silhouette with notched fins and curling claws along the way.

entries.label: Dragon Fullbody

tags.subject: sprawling rose-and-vine cascade, large blooms, scattered petals
tags.style: heavy filled silhouette with organic flow
tags.placement: sprawling across the chest and down the torso

entries.description: A dense cascade of large dark roses and curling foliage sprawls across the upper body, splashing outward in irregular bursts and trailing down toward the hips. Smaller blossoms and torn petals scatter along the edges, giving the piece a wild, almost spilled-ink coverage.

entries.label: Butterfly Womb

tags.subject: twin butterfly wings, central heart, scattered small hearts
tags.placement: low on the belly just above the pubic mound

entries.description: Two ornate butterfly wings flare outward from a small central heart, their inner patterning swirling with curling flourishes. Tiny hearts trail in a dotted line along the top and bottom edges, framing the piece in a delicate heart-bead border.

entries.label: Dragon V 2 Thigh

tags.subject: rearing serpentine dragon, flowing mane, curling tail
tags.style: bold filled silhouette in eastern style
tags.placement: down the outer side of the right thigh

entries.description: A serpentine dragon rears with its head turned upward and a long flowing mane, its body folding into a tall S-curve. The tail unwinds into feathery curls at the base, all rendered as one heavy black silhouette with no inner outline.

entries.label: Dunmer Back

tags.subject: vertical glyph column, runic script, capped ornament
tags.style: engraved scripted column with end caps
tags.placement: down the upper back along the spine

entries.description: A narrow vertical band of runic script runs down the back, terminated at the top by a small capped finial and at the bottom by a round seal with crossbars. The piece reads as a single long inscription, like a tattooed prayer column or sigil-bound text.

entries.label: Ice Wraith Back

tags.subject: twin upswept horn-wings, runic text core, demonic crest
tags.style: filled tribal silhouette with script accent
tags.placement: down the upper back along the spine

entries.description: Two sweeping horn-like wings curve upward from a narrow central column of runic script, forming a high crest at the top. The silhouette is heavy and symmetric, with the script reading like a spine binding the two wings together.

entries.label: Alori Thigh

tags.subject: abstract circular sigil, hooked letterforms, sweeping flourish
tags.placement: high on the outer right thigh near the hip

entries.description: A roughly circular mark blends hooked, letter-like shapes with a long sweeping flourish that curls underneath and wraps around. The whole figure reads as a stylized signature or sigil drawn in one fluid brushstroke.

entries.label: Lust Chest

tags.subject: circular ouroboros, inscribed triangles, winged crest
tags.style: bold filled silhouette with geometric core
tags.placement: centered high on the chest between the collarbones

entries.description: A serpent-like ring encloses a downward triangle nested with smaller triangles, all crowned above by a pair of small bat-like wings. The design reads as a heraldic alchemical seal, equal parts geometric and gothic.

entries.label: Night Is My Veil Back

tags.subject: hooded fox skull, draped roses, hanging skull pendant
tags.placement: down the upper back along the spine

entries.description: A hooded fox-like skull stares forward from beneath a flowing veil, framed by roses and leafy stems that drape behind it. A smaller bone-hung skull pendant dangles below on a thread, finishing the composition with a memento-mori air.

entries.label: Wings Lower Back

tags.subject: outspread feathered wings, mirrored pair, full plumage
tags.placement: across the lower back just above the buttocks

entries.description: Two large feathered wings spread wide from a central point, each feather drawn in clean overlapping outline. The pair forms a strict mirror, opening horizontally like a heraldic emblem rather than folding inward.

entries.label: Daedric Back

tags.subject: vertical incantation, runic letters, tentacled seal
tags.placement: down the upper back along the spine

entries.description: A vertical column of runic incantation runs down the back, capped at the top by a small ankh-like crest and at the bottom by a tentacled circular sigil. The composition reads as a single woven spell-string, more inscription than picture.

entries.label: Revy Arm

tags.subject: spiked tribal flourish, hooked tendrils, single horizontal sweep
tags.placement: wrapped around the upper arm in a horizontal band

entries.description: A series of sharp tribal hooks and curled tendrils sweep along a horizontal axis, the silhouette tapering at the ends and bulging in the middle. The whole piece reads as a single dynamic slash of black ink across the skin.

entries.label: Shura Kirigakure Front

tags.subject: vertical sigil column, framed glyph crown, pointed pendant
tags.placement: down the centerline of the chest and abdomen

entries.description: An elongated narrow sigil runs vertically with a small framed glyph at the top, a beaded waist, and a pointed pendant at the lower end. The piece is strictly bilaterally symmetric and reads as a stylized ceremonial talisman.

entries.label: Nami Arm

tags.subject: stylized pinwheel mark, looping ribbons, single dot
tags.placement: wrapped around the upper arm as a single mark

entries.description: A flowing pinwheel-like figure loops through itself in a single continuous curve, with one dark circular dot tucked into the upper bend. The shape is calligraphic and asymmetric, reading like a personal monogram laid across the skin.

entries.label: Karin Arm

tags.subject: blocky angular glyph, rectangular cutouts, hard right angles
tags.placement: wrapped around the upper arm as a single mark

entries.description: A single bold glyph built from heavy rectangular bars and right angles dominates the design, with several rectangular cutouts inside its body. The piece reads as a printed seal or stylized character, all sharp corners and no curves.

entries.label: Blood Symbol Chest

tags.subject: vertical lidded eye sigil, pointed crown and tail, demonic crest
tags.style: filled tribal silhouette with central eye
tags.placement: centered high on the chest between the collarbones

entries.description: A pointed crest stretches vertically with a single half-lidded eye at its heart, sharp horns rising above and barbed prongs descending below. The silhouette is strictly symmetric, reading as a single sigil with the eye as its focal point.

entries.label: Kitsune Back

tags.subject: fox-eared warrior figure, raised sword, billowing robes
tags.placement: down the upper back along the spine

entries.description: A fox-eared figure in flowing robes stands poised with a sword raised overhead, its tails flaring out behind. The whole piece is a single dark silhouette with sparing white cutouts to indicate eyes and mask, giving the impression of a stage-like shadow figure.

entries.label: Butterflies Back

tags.subject: trailing flower vine, scattered butterflies, leafy curls
tags.style: fine filled silhouette with botanical detail
tags.placement: down the upper back along the spine

entries.description: A long vine of star-petaled flowers and leaves cascades downward with several butterflies woven into the foliage. The arrangement runs as a vertical strand rather than a wide spread, giving the piece a slender, drifting feel.

entries.label: Sanguine Rose Womb

tags.subject: single long-stemmed rose, leaves and thorns, filled bloom
tags.placement: low on the belly just above the pubic mound

entries.description: A single rose blooms at the top of a long straight stem, its petals layered tightly into one solid black mass. A few leaves break from the stem to either side, keeping the silhouette simple and graphic with no inner linework.

entries.label: Dragon Back

tags.subject: coiled serpent dragon, sword spear, twisted chains
tags.style: fine linework with dense scale detail
tags.placement: down the upper back along the spine

entries.description: A scaled serpent dragon winds in a tall vertical coil, gripping a sword-tipped chain that pierces through the body of the coil. The head rears at the top, the tail loops below, and the whole composition is rendered in tight scale-pattern outline rather than filled silhouette.

entries.label: Blood Moon Chest

tags.subject: crescent moon, central teardrop, dripping pendant
tags.placement: centered high on the chest between the collarbones

entries.description: A thick crescent moon opens upward, a smaller teardrop dangling from a thin tether below its midpoint. The shapes are pure filled silhouette with no inner detail, reading as a simple celestial pendant icon.

entries.label: Queen Marika Womb

tags.subject: interlaced ring sigil, crescent arc base, scattered ink
tags.style: rough sketched linework with sprayed texture
tags.placement: low on the belly just above the pubic mound

entries.description: A trio of overlapping rings sits at the center of a wide crescent arc, with a small figure perched above and faint sprayed ink scattered around the whole composition. The lines are sketchy and broken, giving the sigil a weathered, ritual-glyph appearance.
